PaintFE-authored synthetic RGBA image (29x100), encoded with ravif 0.12.0 /
rav1e 0.8.1 at speed 8, quality 100. The PNG reference was decoded independently
with Pillow 13.0.0 / libavif. Covered by PaintFE's project license.

The encoded format is lossy; the PNG is a reference for decoding this particular
bitstream, not an assertion that encoding preserves every original pixel.
